interpretation: Assumed-demand operating experiments, not calibrated Pocket Trains profit predictions. Paired ranges describe only the observed synthetic seeds, not confidence intervals. Forty-eight policy configurations per plan were tuned on separate training seeds; layout geometry was not tuned on evaluation outcomes.

documented: Per-engine job boards refreshed on station arrival, not while waiting

assumed: One identical generic train per active owner, speed 1 distance unit per time unit
Fixed independent one-car offers per arrival; selectable hypothetical destination priors

Uniform 1–4 reward multipliers; payout index = direct separation in the supplied game-map image × multiplier, independent of actual route; 139 manually digitized coordinates remain approximate, not calibrated coins
